info.title: API.SH: CarGurus
info.description: The CarGurus API from API.SH: public CarGurus data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
A CarGurus dealer: id, name, address, position, phone, website, logo, social links, rating, review count and reviews (rating, date, first name, text, helpful votes); its cars, 24 a page (id, link, title, VIN, year, make, model, trim, body, price, original and expected price, price difference, deal rating and score, mileage, days on market, colours, transmission, drivetrain, engine, fuel and MPG, options, image); and other dealers nearby. Pass `next_page` from the previous response; `next_page` is null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/cargurus-dealer

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A CarGurus dealer page (`dealer.url` in /cargurus/v1/listing), or the dealer id in `id`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
CarGurus' used-car price index for a model or a make: the average price today and 30, 90 and 365 days ago with the change (with and without fees), the same for every model year (for a model) or every model (for a make), the overall CarGurus index for comparison, the daily price points behind the chart for the last months, and the site's price FAQ answers.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/cargurus-price-trends

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: CarGurus model id (model_id in /cargurus/v1/search), e.g. d292 for Toyota Camry.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A cargurus.com price-trends page or a search link for a make or model.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Used and new cars for sale in the US, 24 per page, each with CarGurus' deal rating (great, good, fair, high, overpriced), its expected market price and the difference, VIN, mileage, specs and the dealer. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page. Also filters by `body_type`, `transmission`, `fuel`, `color`, `min_mileage` and `features` (sunroof, heated seats, CarPlay and the site's other features and packages).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/cargurus-search

parameters.name: make
parameters.description: Make name, or a CarGurus make id such as m7.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: CarGurus model id (see `model_id` in results, or the d… number in a CarGurus URL); d292 = Toyota Camry.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A CarGurus search page URL (its make/model id is used).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` from the previous response; `next_page` is null on the last page.

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: Exterior color, comma-separated: black, white, silver, gray, red, blue, green, brown, beige, gold, orange, yellow, purple.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
